Effort changes little, but I'll go.
leisure: Free time, fated to pass like all else.
I'll drift where the day takes me.
Whatever I do, it was already chosen.
crime: If it's meant to happen, it will.
I'm only doing what was written for me.
Caught or not, it's already decided.
hygiene: I'll wash, since the day asks it of me.
Clean or dirty, fate doesn't much care.
I suppose it's time; it always is.
money: Rich or poor, the path was set.
Funds are low, as they were destined to be.
I'll earn what I'm meant to, no more.
safety: What comes for me will come, regardless.
I'll hide, though fate sees all anyway.
If danger is written, hiding only delays it.
comfort: A finer place, if it's in the cards.
Comfort or none, the end is the same.
I'll take what fate offers, no striving.
social: Those I'm meant to meet, I'll meet.
Company finds you when it's written to.
I'll talk, if the day arranges it.
idle: The day unfolds as it always would.
I simply wait for what is to come.
Nothing to decide; it's all decided.
familiar: Our paths were always going to cross.
That traveller and I, written, clearly.
Fate keeps returning them to me. So be it.

sleep: Finally, an excuse to be left alone, bed.
I'm exhausted and crankier for it.
Don't wake me. Don't even think about it.
hunger: Hungry. Naturally. Just my luck.
Better find food before I bite someone's head off.
If lunch is cold I swear...
work: Work. Joy. Can't wait.
Another shift with these idiots.
Let's just get this miserable thing over with.
leisure: 'Free time.' Free to be annoyed somewhere else.
I'll go grumble in a quiet corner.
Leave me be and I might enjoy it.
crime: They don't deserve it anyway.
Serves them right, whatever I take.
Bah, maybe. If it's easy.
hygiene: Ugh, fine, I'll wash. Happy now?
I reek and I'm annoyed about it.
Get this over with, like everything else.
money: Broke. Of course. Everything costs too much.
Why is money always the problem?
I'll go scrape some together. Grumble.
safety: Great, now I have to hide too.
I'll lay low, not that I wanted company.
Just leave me out of whatever this is.
comfort: A better place, away from all the noise.
Somewhere people can't bother me.
I deserve some peace, for once.
social: People? Ugh. But I suppose I'm lonely.
Fine, I'll talk. Briefly. Don't push it.
Maybe one person won't irritate me today.
idle: Bah. Quiet for once. Don't ruin it.
Whatever. As long as nobody bugs me.
Of course nothing's going right. Typical.
familiar: Oh, it's you again. Hmph.
That traveller's... less annoying than most.
Don't tell them, but I don't mind them around.

sleep: I'll rest, then be ready for them at dawn.
Sleep now, so I can stand watch tomorrow.
Even the devoted need their rest.
hunger: I'll eat, to keep my strength for those who rely on me.
A meal, then back to my post.
Can't watch over anyone on an empty stomach.
work: I gave my word; I'll see the shift through.
Honest work for the people I serve.
I won't let my comrades down.
leisure: A little rest, I'll check on my friends after.
Free time's better spent with those I trust.
I'll keep an ear out, just in case.
crime: No, it would shame those who trust me.
I'd never betray what we stand for.
My honor is owed to my friends.
hygiene: I'll tidy up; I represent my people.
A quick wash, must do my comrades proud.
Presentable, for those who count on me.
money: I need enough to support my own.
Funds are low; I'll provide for the group.
I'd give my last coin to a friend in need.
safety: I'll lay low, but I won't leave anyone behind.
Stay safe, so I can keep my promises.
I guard what matters, even from the shadows.
comfort: A home where my friends are always welcome.
A hearth to share with those I love.
Comfort means a door open to my people.
social: I should check in on my friends.
Time spent with allies is never wasted.
I miss the company of those I trust.
idle: I'll stand ready, should anyone need me.
All's well with my own. Good.
I keep faith, quietly, always.
familiar: That traveller stood by me, I won't forget it.
An ally worth keeping close.
I'd have their back without a second thought.

thoughts: This is scary, but I must act.

sleep: Rest up, tomorrow may need a steady hand.
I'll sleep, then face whatever comes.
Even the bold must close their eyes sometime.
hunger: I'll eat, strength now, courage later.
Fuel up; you can't be brave on empty.
A good meal steadies the nerves.
work: No task too hard, I'll take it head on.
I'll handle the dangerous parts myself.
Someone has to step up. Might as well be me.
leisure: A breather, then on to the next challenge.
I'll see what daring fun I can find.
Rest is fine, but I'd rather be doing.
crime: No, courage isn't the same as recklessness.
I face danger, I don't create it for others.
There's no honor in stealing.
hygiene: Quick wash, can't charge into things filthy.
I'll clean up and stand tall.
A soldier keeps himself sharp.
money: Low on coin, I'll earn it the hard way, gladly.
I'll take the risky job others won't.
Money's just another mountain to climb.
safety: Hiding goes against the grain, but it's smart now.
I'll lay low, then face it on my terms.
Retreat isn't surrender; I'll be back.
comfort: A solid home base to return to after the fight.
Somewhere to rest these battle-worn bones.
I've earned a roof worth standing under.
social: I'd welcome a comrade for the road ahead.
Bold company makes for good stories.
Let's find someone with heart.
idle: Quiet for now, I'll savor it.
Ready for whatever steps out of the shadows.
Calm before the next test. I'm steady.
familiar: That traveller doesn't flinch, I respect that.
We've faced things together; I'd fight beside them.
A brave heart knows another.

thoughts: Maybe someone else can handle this?

sleep: I just want to curl up somewhere safe.
Maybe sleep will make the worry stop.
Home, blankets, quiet... please.
hunger: I'm hungry, but I don't want to make a fuss.
Maybe I can find food where no one's looking.
I should eat... if it's not too crowded.
work: I hope no one expects too much of me.
I'll just keep my head down and work.
Please let the shift be uneventful.
leisure: A quiet spot, away from the crowd.
I'd like to relax, somewhere out of sight.
Free time is nicest when I'm alone.
crime: Oh no, no, I could never.
What if someone sees? I'd faint.
I can't, I'm shaking just thinking it.
hygiene: I'll wash quietly, where it's empty.
I hope no one notices I needed to.
Just a quick wash, then back to hiding.
money: I'm running low, and it scares me.
I don't want to ask anyone for help...
Maybe a small, quiet job somewhere.
safety: Yes, hide. Hiding is good. Stay small.
Please don't let them find me.
I'll stay very, very still.
comfort: A safe little place all my own would be heaven.
Somewhere with a lock and a warm corner.
I just want somewhere I feel secure.
social: I'd like a friend, if they're gentle...
Maybe I'll say hello. Maybe.
Talking is scary, but I'm lonely.
idle: It's quiet. That's... good, I think.
I hope nothing bad happens.
Just stay out of the way, that's safest.
familiar: Oh, that traveller. They're not so scary.
I feel a bit braver when they're near.
Maybe... maybe I can trust them.

thoughts: If it feels good, do it.
Life is short, enjoy it now.
I need more wine. And cheese.

sleep: A long, luxurious sleep, yes please.
I'll sink into the softest bed I can find.
Sleep is just another pleasure to savor.
hunger: Ooh, time for something delicious!
I want the finest meal I can get.
Food is one of life's great joys.
work: Work, ugh, but it pays for the pleasures.
I'll do the minimum and enjoy the rest.
Let's get this over with, then play.
leisure: At last, time for indulgence!
Wine, music, good company, bring it all.
This is what life is for!
crime: If it gets me what I want... maybe.
A little indulgence never hurt, much.
Why deny myself? Take the pleasure.
hygiene: A long, warm soak sounds divine.
I'll pamper myself a little, why not?
Clean and perfumed, the way I like it.
money: Running low? But the good life isn't cheap!
I'll find some money to fund the fun.
Worth every coin, while it lasts.
safety: Lay low? But comfortably, I insist.
I'll hide somewhere with decent wine.
Even hiding should be pleasant.
comfort: A lavish place to enjoy life properly!
Soft cushions, fine things, yes, all of it.
Comfort? That's what I'm here for!
social: A party isn't a party alone!
I crave good company and laughter.
Let's find someone to share the fun with.
idle: Mmm, what delight shall I chase next?
Life's a feast, I intend to taste it.
So many pleasures, so little time.
familiar: That traveller! Always good for a fun time.
We should share a drink, they and I.
Pleasant company, that one. I approve.

sleep: Eh, might as well sleep. Nothing else to do.
Tired. Whatever. I'll lie down.
Sleep, wake, repeat. Sure.
hunger: Suppose I should eat. Or not.
Hungry, I guess. I'll grab whatever.
Food. Meh. Fine.
work: Work. Again. Sure, whatever.
I'll do the shift. Doesn't matter how.
Clock in, clock out. Same as always.
leisure: Free time. I'll just... sit, probably.
Could do something. Won't, though.
Doesn't matter how I spend it.
crime: Eh. Effort. Not worth it.
Could steal it. Can't be bothered.
Whatever, I don't need it that bad.
hygiene: Should probably wash. Eventually.
Eh, fine, I'll clean up. I guess.
Doesn't really bother me, but okay.
money: Low on cash. Eh. It is what it is.
Should earn some. Maybe later.
Money, no money, same difference.
safety: Hide? Sure, less effort than dealing with it.
Eh, I'll lay low. Easier that way.
Whatever's coming, coming.
comfort: A nicer place? Eh, this one's fine.
Could upgrade. Can't be bothered, really.
Comfort, sure, if it falls in my lap.
social: People, I guess. If they come to me.
Could talk to someone. Meh.
Company's fine. Or not. Whatever.
idle: ...nothing. As usual.
Just another day doing nothing much.
Meh. The hours pass.
familiar: Oh, that one again. Cool, I guess.
They're around a lot. Doesn't bother me.
Eh. They're alright, I suppose.

cooking_station: Cooking for myself beats buying out.
I should do that more often.
container: You'd be surprised what people leave lying around.
rentable_room: A real bed for once, wonderful.
Worth every coin for a good night's sleep.
apiary: The hives are doing well this season.
bank: Better safe than sorry, into the vault it goes.
Banks. Can't live with them, can't live without them.
real_estate_office: Property really does pay for itself.
Owning land was the smartest thing I ever did.
stock_exchange: The market giveth and the market taketh away.
I'll make it back next time.
furniture_builder: A few new touches and this place feels like home.
Nice things make a house a home.
